author: IBM Technology
description:
Learn more about AI Debugging here → https://ibm.biz/~i26jCJsKx

The same AI model can produce different results across accelerators. Kaoutar El Maghraoui explains AI model debugging by finding the first observed divergence between executions. Learn how tensor comparisons, tolerances, and minimal tests help isolate failures.

 00:00 – Debug Different AI Model Results Across Accelerators
 00:53 – Trace Errors Through the AI Software Stack
 02:40 – Separate Expected Variation from Correctness Bugs
 03:05 – See How Small Differences Propagate Through Models
 04:45 – Localize the Difference Before Diagnosing It
 05:52 – Build a Validated Reference Execution
 06:50 – Find the First Observed Divergence
 08:42 – Compare Tensors with Numerical Tolerances
 10:23 – Isolate the Operation with a Minimal Test
 12:32 – Turn the Fix into a Regression Test
